pr.title: KAFKA-17741: Cleanup code base for JDK 11
pr.body:
JIRA: [KAFKA-17741](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-17741)
>We are planning to drop JDK 8. This is part of the upgrade from JDK 8 to JDK 11. You can see the full plan here: [KAFKA-12894](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-12894)
> 1. `KafkaCompletableFuture` has many override methods from java 9, and they all need `@Override`annotation
> 2. remove `IS_JAVA9_COMPATIBLE` and `IS_JAVA11_COMPATIBLE`

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation 
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
